faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Everything You Need to Know Before Ordering
faq.a1: We deliver within 2-5 business days from order confirmation. We ship to all governorates in Egypt.
faq.q2: Can I pay cash on delivery?
faq.a2: Yes — we offer cash on delivery across Egypt. You can also pay via InstaPay.
faq.q3: Can I return my order if I don't like it?
faq.a3: Yes, we offer a 14-day return and exchange policy, provided the item is in its original condition.
faq.q4: Can you improve a low-quality photo?
faq.a4: Yes. We can improve clarity, color, and some visible noise depending on the original file. Facial features will not be changed unless specifically requested.
faq.q5: Can I use my own design?
faq.a5: Of course! Upload your image and we'll enhance it professionally before printing and turn it into a premium framed poster.
